title: FBI-UAP-D019, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 2-4, Western United States Event, 2023
doc_notes: This document is a digital rendering and narrative statement created by the FBI in 2026 based on a 2023 UAP sighting reported by a federal law enforcement agent.

incidents.summary: A federal law enforcement special agent reported observing a horizontal line of four lights, including three red lights and one yellow-white circular light, over a mountain range in the western United States.
incidents.quote: a horizontal line of four lights is visible: three small, distinct red lights followed by a larger, brighter yellow-white circular light
